mode.name: Assisted Flight
mode.note: Once per day. For 10 minutes you can Leap 20 feet and gain a fly Speed equal to your Speed or 25 feet, whichever is greater. You emit bright light in a 20-foot radius (dim light 20 feet beyond), which is why Stealth suffers.

records.reason: Everything it does is aimed at one named creature: that creature suffers invoke true name against your spells, and you may attempt a counteract check when it uses magic on you — a reaction-style action resolved at the table, with no standing bonus to the owner.
